production_rule: Every listed pose is an independently authored full-size image and an independently reviewed RGBA pixel graph. No pose may be duplicated, mirrored, warped, or padded from another slot.

preserve: approved warm face and skin tone
long voluminous brown curls with stable length and volume
adult voxel proportions, cube scale, and natural anatomy
high-waisted charcoal full-length leggings with alpine-blue side detail
stable midriff interval, garment coverage, strap width, waistband height, and shoe construction
globally_forbidden: cropped hair, hands, feet, or detached owned pixels

g1.name: Profile walk foundation
g1.authored_loop_policy: Frames 003 through 006 may cycle only as a subrange after frame 006 to frame 003 contact and root deltas pass; the complete six-frame phrase does not loop.

frames.pose_summary: Grounded screen-right profile idle with quiet route awareness.
frames.continuity: Both trail shoes are planted on baseline 1185, spine tall but relaxed, arms hanging with slight asymmetry, curls settled behind the shoulders, and gaze level toward the route.
frames.forbidden: Front or three-quarter facing, contrapposto that lifts a foot, yoga pose, prop, closed or hidden hands, hair crop, or outfit drift.

frames.pose_summary: Small pre-step load into the rear leg.
frames.continuity: The pelvis shifts slightly screen-left over the rear foot, front knee releases, torso inclines minimally forward, and opposing arms begin their swing without changing scale.
frames.forbidden: Deep squat, heel teleport, visible root travel, arm symmetry, hair snap, changed garment coverage, or exaggerated athletic pose.

frames.pose_summary: Screen-right leading heel contact with trailing toe retained.
frames.continuity: Front heel meets baseline while the rear toe remains in contact, legs form a readable stride, anatomical left arm opposes the leading leg, and curls lag slightly behind travel.
frames.forbidden: Both feet flat, floating feet, same-side arm and leg swing, stretched anatomy, root jump, hair leading the body, or shoe redesign.

frames.pose_summary: Single-support passing pose with the free foot beneath the pelvis.
frames.continuity: The planted foot is flat, free foot passes close to the support ankle without touching, pelvis rises slightly, arms cross neutral, and hair follows a continuous backward arc.
frames.forbidden: Two-foot contact, airborne support foot, wide split, knee inversion, arm pop, root reversal, or silhouette collision between hand and torso.

frames.pose_summary: Opposite stride extension with practical forward intent.
frames.continuity: The passing leg extends screen-right, support heel begins a controlled rise, arm swing reaches its opposite extrema, and curls trail farther without changing length or volume.
frames.forbidden: Run flight, locked knees, toe penetration, oversized stride, arm duplication, hair detachment, or midriff/waistband drift.

frames.pose_summary: Opposite contact and stable recovery marker.
frames.continuity: The new leading heel and old trailing toe share baseline contact, torso returns over the stride, arms reverse cleanly, and the pose can hand off to idle or back to frame 003 without root or hair snap.
frames.forbidden: Duplicate of frame 003, frozen arms, mismatched root height, foot skate, abrupt hair reset, or ungrounded handoff.

g2.name: Faster profile gait and walk-to-run transition
g2.authored_loop_policy: Frame 012 to frame 007 must preserve lead-contact phase, root delta, and hair-arc continuity before the whole sequence is admitted as a loop.

frames.pose_summary: Longer, lower profile contact initiating acceleration.
frames.continuity: Leading heel and trailing toe contact baseline, torso leans modestly forward, elbows bend for a faster swing, and curls trail with more amplitude than G1.
frames.forbidden: Sprint crouch, both feet flat, vertical bounce, same-side limb swing, hair crop, or scale change.

frames.pose_summary: Loaded down phase accepting the faster contact.
frames.continuity: Leading foot becomes flat, knee absorbs weight, rear foot releases, pelvis reaches the cycle low point, and arms continue through opposing arcs.
frames.forbidden: Deep jump squat, rear-foot ghost contact, pelvis pop, elbow discontinuity, or garment deformation.

frames.pose_summary: Compact fast passing pose under the hips.
frames.continuity: Free knee passes forward, support leg extends, torso stays aligned over travel, arms cross neutral quickly, and curls lag as one connected mass.
frames.forbidden: Foot clipping, airborne support, excessive knee lift, twisted torso, hair separation, or hand-to-body merge.

frames.pose_summary: Forefoot push transitioning from fast walk into run.
frames.continuity: Support heel is high, trailing leg extends behind, forward knee drives, elbows reach stronger opposition, and body inclination remains practical rather than theatrical.
frames.forbidden: Two-foot contact, knee hyperextension, superhero pose, clenched oversized fists, hair leading, or root reversal.

frames.pose_summary: Brief readable run flight with compact legs.
frames.continuity: Both shoes clear baseline by a small believable interval, forward knee leads, rear leg recovers, torso and hair continue the same ballistic arc, and hands remain readable.
frames.forbidden: Large leap, split legs, baseline contact, floating hair fragments, body stretch, or changed shoe size.

frames.pose_summary: Opposite forefoot landing prepared for the next run cycle.
frames.continuity: New leading forefoot contacts baseline under a bent knee, trailing leg remains airborne, arms reverse, and curls continue their delayed arc for a clean loop or deceleration handoff.
frames.forbidden: Heel-first stiff landing, dual contact, root snap, frozen hair, identical silhouette to frame 007, or foot skate.

g3.name: Trail sprint, launch, clearance, and descent
g3.authored_loop_policy: Non-looping committed jump phrase; exit only through G4 landing recovery.

motion_contract.interrupt_policy: frames_001_and_002_are_safe; frame_003_commits; committed motion must complete through g4 frame_005

frames.pose_summary: Decisive trail plant that prepares obstacle clearance.
frames.continuity: Lead forefoot plants under the body, rear leg reaches back, torso lowers, arms counterbalance, and gaze tracks the imagined route without introducing scenery.
frames.forbidden: Visible obstacle, bicycle cue, heel strike, prayer hands, hair crop, or off-baseline plant.

frames.pose_summary: Deep but athletic two-foot compression.
frames.continuity: Both shoes are grounded, hips and knees flex in aligned tracks, arms sweep behind, spine remains long, and curls settle forward from deceleration.
frames.forbidden: Yoga squat, knees collapsing inward, heels floating, hands touching floor, mystical expression, or costume compression.

frames.pose_summary: Committed two-foot toe launch.
frames.continuity: Legs extend through aligned ankles, both forefeet retain the final contact, arms drive forward and upward, torso begins a screen-right arc, and curls lag below the launch.
frames.forbidden: One-foot launch, bent collapsing ankles, giant vertical leap, arm teleport, detached curls, or backward travel.

frames.pose_summary: Compact airborne ascent with route-focused posture.
frames.continuity: Both feet clear baseline, knees begin to fold beneath the pelvis, arms open for balance, gaze remains forward, and hair trails downward along the launch arc.
frames.forbidden: Flying pose, split leap, wings, visible obstacle, extreme back arch, or baseline contact.

frames.pose_summary: Apex clearance with knees compact and lateral balance readable.
frames.continuity: Knees tuck only enough for practical clearance, feet remain separated and anatomically oriented, arms counterbalance asymmetrically, torso reaches arc apex, and curls float at maximum lag.
frames.forbidden: Cannonball, lotus legs, touching knees to chest, crossed ankles, levitation expression, or hair volume mutation.

frames.pose_summary: Prepared descent with feet reaching for landing.
frames.continuity: Feet extend below the pelvis with forefeet slightly leading, knees remain soft, arms widen for balance, torso descends screen-right, and gaze moves toward the landing point.
frames.forbidden: Baseline contact, locked knees, heel-first reach, body rotation to front, root reversal, or hair snap to rest.

g4.name: Landing, balance correction, settle, and greeting
g4.authored_loop_policy: Hold frame 006 or exit through a legal handoff; never replay the landing as an automatic loop.

frames.pose_summary: Two-foot forefoot landing contact from G3.
frames.continuity: Both forefeet meet baseline with soft aligned knees, heels still slightly raised, arms remain wide from descent, and curls continue downward rather than snapping.
frames.forbidden: Flat stiff landing, one missing foot, rearward root jump, front-facing cut, collapsed knees, or settled hair.

frames.pose_summary: Deep aligned absorption of landing force.
frames.continuity: Heels lower to baseline as hips and knees flex, torso inclines over the feet, arms sweep forward, and curls overshoot before settling.
frames.forbidden: Yoga squat, hands on floor, foot slide, knees inward, torso collapse, or hair clipping through shoulders.

frames.pose_summary: Small lateral recovery step showing trail balance.
frames.continuity: Near foot remains planted while the far foot makes one short side correction, torso counters over the support, hands stay open, and hair follows the lateral shift.
frames.forbidden: Large stumble, crossed feet, fear expression, arms flailing overhead, root teleport, or duplicate landing pose.

frames.pose_summary: Controlled counterbalance returning weight to center.
frames.continuity: Both feet regain clear contact, pelvis returns between them, one open arm remains slightly extended while the other lowers, and torso rotates toward three-quarter.
frames.forbidden: T-pose, mirrored arms, lifted foot, sudden front cut, prayer gesture, or outfit/hair drift.

frames.pose_summary: Breath-led three-quarter settle after the landing.
frames.continuity: Knees lengthen without locking, shoulders drop on a quiet exhale, arms return near the sides, curls settle naturally, and both shoes stay anchored.
frames.forbidden: Named yoga pose, chest thrust, closed eyes in trance, foot movement, idle duplicate, or sudden hair symmetry.

frames.pose_summary: Warm compact greeting after a successful recovery.
frames.continuity: One hand lifts only to lower-chest height in a small open acknowledgment, the other remains relaxed, weight stays centered, and expression warms without becoming performative.
frames.forbidden: Big wave, prayer hands, bow, peace sign, finger point, lifted heel, or prop.

g5.name: Front approach and compact forward hop
g5.authored_loop_policy: Non-looping approach-and-hop phrase with a grounded endpoint.

frames.pose_summary: Canonical front idle for motion handoffs.
frames.continuity: Both shoes are planted symmetrically enough for a neutral handoff, hands rest open beside the thighs, shoulders are easy, curls frame the same approved face, and outfit geometry matches the identity frame.
frames.forbidden: Copying the identity file byte-for-byte, prop, model pose, hip exaggeration, crossed legs, cropped curls, or changed neckline.

frames.pose_summary: Anatomical left foot approaches camera in contact.
frames.continuity: Left foot lands slightly larger and lower in perspective, right toe remains behind, pelvis counters naturally, right arm swings forward, and body scale changes only by the prescribed root approach.
frames.forbidden: Profile rotation, giant perspective foot, same-side arm swing, floating rear foot, root lateral jump, or garment distortion.

frames.pose_summary: Centered front passing pose with one support leg.
frames.continuity: Left foot supports under the body, right foot passes close to center, hips stay level, arms cross neutral, and curls show only slight approach bounce.
frames.forbidden: Feet merged into one shape, side lean, airborne support, excessive scale growth, arm overlap, or face drift.

frames.pose_summary: Anatomical right foot takes the next approach contact.
frames.continuity: Right foot leads with left toe trailing, left arm swings forward, torso remains front-facing, and visual scale progresses consistently from frames 026-027.
frames.forbidden: Duplicate of frame 026, mirrored pixels, profile drift, foot skate, root shrink, or hair snap.

frames.pose_summary: Centered two-foot compression for a compact forward hop.
frames.continuity: Both feet plant parallel on baseline, knees track over shoes, hips lower, arms sweep behind, spine stays long, and curls shift forward with the load.
frames.forbidden: Yoga squat, wide sumo stance, knees inward, hands clasped, heels floating, sexualized pose, or prop.

frames.pose_summary: Compact forward-hop landing with quiet athletic control.
frames.continuity: Both forefeet have landed slightly closer to camera, knees absorb softly, arms open low for balance, hair still carries a small upward lag, and the pose can settle to front idle without a scale pop.
frames.forbidden: Airborne endpoint, giant jump, one-foot landing, stiff knees, root lateral offset, hair reset, or changed body proportions.

g6.name: Rear departure, acceleration, hop, and recovery
g6.authored_loop_policy: Non-looping departure-and-hop phrase with a grounded endpoint.

frames.pose_summary: Canonical rear idle proving hair, straps, waistband, and shoes.
frames.continuity: Both feet plant on baseline, curls retain approved length and volume across the back, sports-bra straps and legging waistband are anatomically consistent, and hands remain visible.
frames.forbidden: Missing back garment construction, hair curtain that erases torso, front face fragments, prop, heel lift, or silhouette crop.

frames.pose_summary: Anatomical left step departing away from camera.
frames.continuity: Left foot lands ahead and slightly smaller in perspective, right toe trails, right arm swings forward, torso stays rear-facing, and curls begin a gentle opposite sway.
frames.forbidden: Profile turn, reversed arm swing, disappearing foot, abrupt scale shrink, hair clipping, or waistband change.

frames.pose_summary: Rear-view passing phase beneath the pelvis.
frames.continuity: Left foot supports, right foot passes near center, arms cross neutral, shoulders stay level, and curls follow rather than obscure all limb motion.
frames.forbidden: Merged legs, airborne support, front-facing head, scale jump, arm disappearance, or hair-length mutation.

frames.pose_summary: Right-foot departure contact with stronger forward drive.
frames.continuity: Right foot contacts farther away, left toe releases, elbows bend, torso inclines slightly into travel, and hair drag increases without detaching.
frames.forbidden: Sprint start blocks, same-side swing, giant lean, foot skate, root lateral drift, or hair snap.

frames.pose_summary: Small rear-view two-foot hop in flight.
frames.continuity: Both feet clear baseline by a restrained amount, knees fold beneath the body, arms open for balance, body recedes consistently, and curls lag downward.
frames.forbidden: Large leap, split legs, profile rotation, baseline contact, wings, yoga shape, or root enlargement.

frames.pose_summary: Rear-view dual-foot landing and travel recovery.
frames.continuity: Both forefeet contact baseline at the smaller departure scale, knees absorb, arms lower, curls retain residual lift, and the root can hold rear idle or turn through an approved anchor.
frames.forbidden: One-foot landing, stiff legs, instant full-size reset, hair at rest, unapproved turn, or missing back garment details.

g7.name: Peer coaching exchange
g7.authored_loop_policy: Hold frame 003 or frame 006; never auto-loop the full coaching exchange.

frames.pose_summary: Grounded recognition that a peer needs support.
frames.continuity: Weight shifts subtly toward the partner, head inclines, both hands stay low and open, shoes remain planted, and expression becomes attentive without alarm.
frames.forbidden: Wave, point, startle, foot movement, pity expression, mystical gaze, prop, or crossed arms.

frames.pose_summary: Low open-palm invitation to speak.
frames.continuity: One palm rises only to waist height, torso opens gently toward the peer, opposite hand remains relaxed, gaze is receptive, and feet do not move.
frames.forbidden: Wave, command, finger point, prayer hands, raised elbow, duplicated fingers, root drift, or broad smile.

frames.pose_summary: Patient active listening with contained breath.
frames.continuity: Hands return near the torso without closing, shoulders soften, head tilt reduces, ribcage settles on an exhale, and eye line remains on the peer.
frames.forbidden: Caricature nod, closed eyes, crossed arms, hands on hips, foot slide, smile performance, or meditation cue.

frames.pose_summary: Small two-part gesture that offers another way to see the problem.
frames.continuity: Near hand indicates the current idea low at center, far hand opens slightly outward to present an alternative, torso remains grounded, and expression stays collaborative.
frames.forbidden: Finger wag, lecture pose, shrug, hands above shoulders, judgmental face, foot movement, or prop metaphor.

frames.pose_summary: Warm practical encouragement with one forward open hand.
frames.continuity: One palm offers forward at lower-chest height while the other stays near center, knees remain soft, shoulders are open, and expression brightens modestly.
frames.forbidden: Cheerleader pose, fist pump, thumbs-up caricature, touch toward camera, oversized hands, heel lift, or romantic framing.

frames.pose_summary: Open choice returned to the peer.
frames.continuity: The offered palm turns slightly upward and lowers, the other arm releases, torso settles back to neutral, gaze remains patient, and both feet stay available for a legal idle handoff.
frames.forbidden: Command gesture, point, dismissal, hands on hips, root displacement, idle duplicate, or performative bow.

g8.name: Post-effort recovery reset
g8.authored_loop_policy: Hold frame 006 or restart at frame 001 only after exact root and contact match; the complete sequence is not an automatic runtime loop.

frames.pose_summary: Post-effort arrival with believable elevated breath.
frames.continuity: Feet plant slightly wider than neutral, knees remain soft, arms hang with residual effort, shoulders sit modestly high, and curls retain a last trace of motion.
frames.forbidden: Hands on knees, collapse, panting caricature, sweat symbols, prop, closed eyes, or yoga stance.

frames.pose_summary: Deliberate even-footed grounding without a named posture.
frames.continuity: Weight spreads evenly through both shoes, pelvis stacks over feet, hands remain open beside the thighs, gaze steadies, and hair settles by gravity.
frames.forbidden: Mountain-pose imitation, prayer hands, ritual gesture, mystical face, feet touching, or rigid military posture.

frames.pose_summary: Visible controlled exhale through shoulders and ribcage.
frames.continuity: Shoulders lower, sternum softens, lower ribs narrow subtly, hands release farther open, knees stay unlocked, and face remains present rather than trance-like.
frames.forbidden: Closed-eye meditation, dramatic sigh, bent collapse, hand mudra, mouth exaggeration, foot shift, or garment deformation.

frames.pose_summary: Practical shoulder and upper-back release.
frames.continuity: One shoulder rolls back while the opposite arm hangs loose, torso rotates only a few degrees, pelvis stays centered, hands remain unshaped, and curls follow the small turn.
frames.forbidden: Yoga bind, arm overhead, neck wrench, gym stretch display, prayer gesture, foot movement, or hair collision.

frames.pose_summary: Balanced recenter after the mobility release.
frames.continuity: Shoulders level, head returns over sternum, weight comes back between both feet, arms hang with natural asymmetry, breath looks settled, and hair returns through a continuous arc.
frames.forbidden: Perfect mirrored symmetry, attention pose, closed fists, lifted heel, instant hair reset, or identity-frame duplicate.

frames.pose_summary: Restored practical readiness with calm route awareness.
frames.continuity: One foot angles slightly toward the next travel direction without leaving baseline, arms remain available, gaze lifts to the route, shoulders stay easy, and the pose supports idle, walk, or coaching handoff.
frames.forbidden: Hero pose, hands on hips, starting-block crouch, mystical smile, lifted foot, prop, or frozen symmetry.
